added.summary: Forced colours mode forces a document's colours (CSS Color Adjust 1 §3.1). With `Viewport.forcedColors` on, an author's colours become system colours, which are the style's roles. A background takes the system colour paired with the element's `color` and keeps its own alpha. Other colours fall back to their user-agent values (`currentcolor` or the inherited ink). `box-shadow`, `text-shadow` and images without `url()` become `none`, and `accent-color` and `scrollbar-color` become `auto`. `forced-color-adjust: auto | none | preserve-parent-color` (inherited) opts an element out. Default frames do not change.
